articles.title: 'Dai Dai' Dominates: Shakira & Burna Boy's World Cup Anthem Holds #1, Ariana Grande Rebounds on Global Charts
articles.summary: Shakira and Burna Boy's 'Dai Dai' just locked in a second week at #1 on the Global Excl. U.S. chart, a first for any World Cup anthem. The track was performed for 80,000+ fans at the opening ceremony. Ariana Grande's 'Hate That I Made You Love Me' returned to #1 on the Global 200.

articles.title: Minions & Monsters Opens Lower Than Expected, But Don't Count the Yellow Guys Out Yet
articles.summary: 'Minions & Monsters' debuted to $36.4 million domestically over the Fourth of July weekend, a franchise low. But it's already earned $98.4 million overseas and boasts a 91% Rotten Tomatoes score — the highest for any Illumination film. With an $85 million budget, it's still poised for profit.

articles.title: Arkane Lyon's Fate Uncertain as Founder Publicly Asks Xbox CEO 'How Much?'
articles.summary: With Arkane Lyon facing potential closure or sale amid Xbox's restructuring, founder Raphael Colantonio tweeted at CEO Asha Sharma: 'Regarding Arkane… how much? I'm asking for a friend.' The studio is in consultation with its works council, and Marvel's Blade hangs in the balance.
